{{MEinfobox|name=Sin Resonance|cg=Sin.png}}'''Sin Resonance''' is a [[Battles|combat]] mechanic in ''[[Limbus Company (game)|Limbus Company]]''. Currently, only the Sinners and the [[Peccatula#Invidiae|Peccatula Invidiae]] are capable of utilizing the mechanic.

==Battle Information==
[[File:Tutorial ResonDifferences.png|550px|class=responsive-image|center]]
Sin Resonance occurs when multiple Skills of the same Affinity are selected for use on the Dashboard. There are two types of Sin Resonance.

===Resonance===
[[File:Tutorial Reson.jpg|120px|class=responsive-image|center]]
Sin Resonance—shortened to "Reson." in the game—occurs when 2 or more Skills of the same Affinity are selected on the Dashboard, indicated by a corresponding '(AFFINITY)RES' label appearing besides each Skill's icon (i.e. "GLUT.RES" for {{Icons|Gluttony}}Gluttony Resonance).

[[File:Tutorial ResonPassive.jpg|550px|class=responsive-image|center]]
Some Skill Effects and Passives conditionally activate depending on Sin Resonance for the Turn. For Passives, their activation is indicated by their names appearing over a Skill.

===Absolute Resonance===
Absolute Sin Resonance—shortened to "A-Reson." in the game—occurs when 3 or more Skills of the same Affinity are selected consecutively, indicated by the "A-RES" label appearing on each Skill's icon.

[[File:Tutorial AbsResonSplit.jpg|750px|class=responsive-image|center]]
Separate chains of Absolute Sin Resonance are counted separately rather than in a sum, meaning 2 instances of 3 A-Reson. on the Dashboard will only count as 3 A-Reson. rather than 6.

Absolute Sin Resonance also counts as regular Sin Resonance, meaning 4 A-Reson. will count as 4 Reson. as well.

===Offense/Defense Level Gain===
Aside from activating Passives, E.G.O Gifts and Skill effects, Sin Resonance can also grant Skills an increase in Offense/Defense Level. Normal Resonance increases such stats in an increasing manner, meaning that the Skills on the right of the chain will gain more Offense/Defense Level, while Absolute Resonance grants all involved Skills an equal increase in Offense/Defense Level.

This can allow for underleveled Identities to Clash as well as one of normal Level, while the ones of normal Level will gain even more Clash Power and deal more damage.
